## Summary

Describe the implemented change and its remaining scope.

## Issue

Link related issues with `Refs #<issue-number>` and state any remaining scope.
Feature PRs target `dev`. Close completed issues manually after verifying acceptance
and merge; PR creation does not close them.

## Verification

- Record actual commands and results. Distinguish local results from hosted CI.
- Note any device/service checks that remain unverified.
- Exclude local paths, account/device identifiers, credentials and private content.
